Bill.BriefDescription: Eliminating the building code council account.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to funding for the state building code council; andamending RCW 19.27.085.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 19.27.085 and 1989 c 256 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (((1) There is hereby created the building code council account inthe state treasury. Moneys deposited into the account shall be used bythe building code council, after appropriation, to perform the purposesof the council. (2) All moneys collected under subsection (3) of this section shallbe deposited into the building code council account. Every four yearsthe state treasurer shall report to the legislature on the balances inthe account so that the legislature may adjust the charges imposedunder subsection (3) of this section. (3))) There is imposed a fee of four dollars and fifty cents oneach building permit issued by a county or a city, plus an additionalsurcharge of two dollars for each residential unit, but not includingthe first unit, on each building containing more than one residentialunit. Quarterly each county and city shall remit moneys collected p. 1 HB 2880under this section to the state treasury; however, no remittance isrequired until a minimum of fifty dollars has accumulated pursuant tothis subsection.
